findings.title: The concluded state is described by a single citing exploration, narrower than its rule
findings.recommendation: orbit-architecture-engine reaches `concluded` when no live work cites the stage and ANY concluded exploration does, so two concluded explorations still give `concluded`. 'when its only citing exploration ended without a change' reads as one exploration. Say 'when the explorations citing it concluded without a change'.

findings.title: The shared-prompts caveat follows the command that deletes them
findings.recommendation: The fence still removes `~/.codex/prompts/opsx-*`, and the warning to leave them for other OpenSpec projects comes after it, so a reader who copies the command loses them first. Put the caveat before the fence, or move the prompts into a second command line the caveat introduces.

walk_entry.title: The Codex removal line deletes prompts that other OpenSpec projects on the machine still use, and ignores CODEX_HOME

findings.title: The walk's fingerprint stamp is outside every walk entry's edit record
findings.recommendation: The residual check lists `.openspec.yaml`, changed by the `orbit fingerprint` stamp that carried the residue requirement (the CoStrict entry), but no entry's file or ripple_cascade.applied names it. A record gap, not a defect: name it in the next walk entry that touches the delta.

commentary: The X1 rule was read across all four of its sites side by side: the guide's command and table, the delta's move-steps rows and scenario, the init warning and its test, and the rerun transcript, whose 4B prints nothing for `find orbit -type f` and whose 4C prints the exploration. They agree. The CoStrict carry was read as a block: the new identifier row, the whole-substring sentence and the scenario all name `.cospec/openspec/`, the helper and the residue test carry it, and no other spec restates the identifier list. The two regressions are both wording that came in with a fix: one sentence narrower than the rule it paraphrases, one caveat placed after the command it qualifies.
